## What's Changed
* docs(agents): main has a merge queue; queue pull requests with --auto by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1159
* feat(export): --graphdb answers the exported graph pane's Cypher in the browser by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1166
* feat(ask-demo): record the ask demo's loop from real behold answers on emulators by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1167
* feat(ask-demo): the page that plays the ask demo's loop by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1170
* feat(ask-demo): serve the ask demo as a Worker, check it, and document it by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1171
* fix(ask-demo): draw the estate graph when the load turn replies by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1173
* feat(ask-demo): replies say the query ran, its row count, and where the Cypher is by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1176
* fix(export): the exported graph pane offers only what works in a static bundle by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1181
* feat(ask-demo): zoom the estate onto what an answer lit, with zoom controls by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1178
* fix(graph): group a Cloud Control index's cannot-list notes by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1179
* feat(graph): LadybugDB's logo beside the Cypher heading, moving while a query runs by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1184
* feat(ask-demo): close the agent's pane a beat after the question's reply by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1186
* docs: a page for the graph database, LadybugDB and Cypher by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1187
* feat(ask-demo): the answer is one picture of what was asked by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1196
* feat(ask-demo): the header says what behold is, what the loop shows, and links the docs by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1194
* feat(ask-demo): visitors read plain words, not wire formats and emulator ids by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1199
* feat(ask-demo): questions read as an operator's worries, and the agent says how it reads each one by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1209
* feat(ask-demo): the answer pane says what was found, and its resources can be selected by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1201
* feat(release): release every behold product on one chant release train by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1212
* feat(ask-demo): play the load turn in full once, and start later questions within a few seconds by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1197
* feat(ask-demo): reveal a question in order: its query, then its answer, then its rows by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1200
* feat(ask-demo): the visitor's turn is a clear state with a countdown, and the page keeps their query by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1207
* fix(surfaces): re-sync the Backstage plugin's behold copies and give argocd-behold Node types by @lex00 in https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/pull/1217


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/INTENTIUS/behold/compare/behold-v0.34.1...behold-v0.34.2
